input_contract: UTF-8 JSON: creator_instruction (plain-language string), event {id,type,message,user {id,name,email,tags,properties},conversation_history:[]}, observed_at (timezone ISO string), approval (not_required|pending|approved|rejected). Optional request_id identifies a repeat. Inputs are synthetic. Support context alerts and message-count thresholds; immediate or explicit scheduled timing; first/every frequency; local_outbox messages and local tag/property updates. Other channels or unspecified essential fields must return needs_clarification rather than silently dropping intent.
output_contract: UTF-8 JSON: status (executed|not_triggered|awaiting_confirmation|needs_clarification|scheduled|already_executed), compiled_plan (validated Replica-owned object or null), trigger_matched (boolean), action_payload (object or null), trigger_occurrences (array), action_occurrences (array), sink_records (array read back from the real local sink), sink_file (relative path to its JSON snapshot), and explanation (string). Preserve event/user IDs. Returned logs are timestamped; no actual email, Slack or external recipient is contacted. sink_records and occurrence arrays in a response are scoped to its event; prior event records remain stored and reusable.
